## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and belongs in this pull request.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or the reason they are unnecessary is explained.
- [ ] Player-facing changes are documented in `README.md` when needed.
- [ ] Release-facing changes are documented in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] No generated runtime files, local configuration, or release JARs are committed.
